name: workspace-builder
description: Build custom digital workspaces (HTML) for different user groups: students, professionals, content creators, parents, and lifestyle users, with responsive design and local data persistence.

displayDescription.en: Build custom digital workspaces for students, professionals, creators, parents, and lifestyle users. Responsive HTML with local data persistence, one-click deployment.
displayDescription.zh: 为不同人群定制专属数字工作台，覆盖学习备考、职场效率、自媒体创作、宝妈育儿、生活管理五大场景，PC/移动端双适配，一键部署即用

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我4岁宝宝做一个识字启蒙工作台，每天学5个字，有象形字卡片、组词练习和闯关积分奖励
defaultInitPrompt.en: Build a literacy learning workspace for my 4-year-old: 5 new characters daily with pictograph cards, word exercises, and point rewards

quickPrompts.en: Build a literacy learning workspace for my 4-year-old: 5 new characters daily with pictograph cards, word exercises, and point rewards
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我4岁宝宝做一个识字启蒙工作台，每天学5个字，有象形字卡片、组词练习和闯关积分奖励

quickPrompts.en: Build a health + finance workspace: daily water/sleep/exercise check-in with weekly charts, plus income/expense tracking with monthly budget pie chart
quickPrompts.zh: 做一个健康打卡+记账理财工作台，包含每日饮水/睡眠/运动打卡和周统计图表，加上收支记录和月度预算饼图

quickPrompts.en: Build a goal planning workspace: monthly goals broken into weekly tasks and daily todos, with progress dashboard and overdue auto-carry-forward
quickPrompts.zh: 搭一个计划表+进度看板工作台，月目标拆解到周任务再到每日待办，带完成率仪表盘和逾期自动顺延
